+"""Persistence and validation for Best Book Award nominations."""
+
+from . import db
+from .bookshelves import Bookshelves
+
+
+class Bestbook(db.CommonExtras):
+    TABLENAME = "bestbook_awards"
+    PRIMARY_KEY = ("username", "work_id")
+    ALLOW_DELETE_ON_CONFLICT = True
+
+    class AwardConditionsError(Exception):
+        """Raised when a nomination violates award eligibility or uniqueness."""
+
+    @classmethod
+    def _work_id(cls, work_id):
+        if work_id is None:
+            return None
+        if isinstance(work_id, str) and work_id.startswith("/works/"):
+            work_id = work_id.rsplit("/", 1)[-1][2:-1]
+        elif isinstance(work_id, str) and work_id.startswith("OL") and work_id.endswith("W"):
+            work_id = work_id[2:-1]
+        return int(work_id)
+
+    @classmethod
+    def get_awards(cls, work_id=None, username=None, topic=None):
+        filters, values = [], {}
+        for name, value in (("work_id", cls._work_id(work_id)), ("username", username), ("topic", topic)):
+            if value is not None:
+                filters.append(f"{name}=${name}")
+                values[name] = value
+        where = " WHERE " + " AND ".join(filters) if filters else ""
+        return list(db.get_db().query(f"SELECT * FROM {cls.TABLENAME}{where}", vars=values))
+
+    @classmethod
+    def get_count(cls, work_id=None, username=None, topic=None):
+        filters, values = [], {}
+        for name, value in (("work_id", cls._work_id(work_id)), ("username", username), ("topic", topic)):
+            if value is not None:
+                filters.append(f"{name}=${name}")
+                values[name] = value
+        where = " WHERE " + " AND ".join(filters) if filters else ""
+        result = db.get_db().query(f"SELECT count(*) FROM {cls.TABLENAME}{where}", vars=values)
+        return result[0]["count"]
+
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate(cls, username, work_id, topic, updating=False):
+        if Bookshelves.user_has_read_work(username, work_id) is False:
+            raise cls.AwardConditionsError("Only books which have been marked as read may be given awards")
+        dbh = db.get_db()
+        by_work = list(
+            dbh.query(
+                f"SELECT * FROM {cls.TABLENAME} WHERE username=$username AND work_id=$work_id",
+                vars={"username": username, "work_id": cls._work_id(work_id)},
+            )
+        )
+        if by_work and not updating:
+            raise cls.AwardConditionsError("You have already given this work an award")
+        by_topic = list(
+            dbh.query(
+                f"SELECT * FROM {cls.TABLENAME} WHERE username=$username AND topic=$topic",
+                vars={"username": username, "topic": topic},
+            )
+        )
+        if any(int(row.work_id) != cls._work_id(work_id) for row in by_topic):
+            raise cls.AwardConditionsError("You have already given an award for this topic")
+
+    @classmethod
+    def add(cls, username, work_id, topic, comment="", edition_id=None):
+        cls._validate(username, work_id, topic)
+        return db.get_db().insert(
+            cls.TABLENAME,
+            username=username,
+            work_id=cls._work_id(work_id),
+            topic=topic,
+            comment=comment or "",
+            edition_id=edition_id,
+        )
+
+    @classmethod
+    def update(cls, username, work_id, topic, comment="", edition_id=None):
+        cls._validate(username, work_id, topic, updating=True)
+        updated = db.get_db().update(
+            cls.TABLENAME,
+            where="username=$username AND work_id=$work_id",
+            topic=topic,
+            comment=comment or "",
+            edition_id=edition_id,
+            vars={"username": username, "work_id": cls._work_id(work_id)},
+        )
+        if not updated:
+            raise cls.AwardConditionsError("You have not given this work an award")
+        return updated
+
+    @classmethod
+    def remove(cls, username, work_id=None, topic=None):
+        filters, values = ["username=$username"], {"username": username}
+        if work_id is not None:
+            values["work_id"] = cls._work_id(work_id)
+            filters.append("work_id=$work_id")
+        if topic is not None:
+            values["topic"] = topic
+            filters.append("topic=$topic")
+        if work_id is None and topic is None:
+            return 0
+        return db.get_db().delete(cls.TABLENAME, where=" AND ".join(filters), vars=values)
+
+    @classmethod
+    def get_leaderboard(cls):
+        return list(db.get_db().query(f"SELECT work_id, count(*) AS count FROM {cls.TABLENAME} GROUP BY work_id ORDER BY count DESC"))
